facts.claim: Since 1 January 2025 Victoria charges a short stay levy of 7.5% of the total booking fee on stays under 28 days in entire homes, apartments and rooms that are not the host's main residence, paid by the booking platform; hotels, motels and hostels are excluded as commercial residential accommodation.

facts.claim: For AO 2026 (12 January to 1 February 2026) Transport Victoria ran Route 70 and 70a trams to the Garden Square and Grand Slam Oval entrances, free for AO ticket holders between Docklands and John Cain Arena; walks of 10 minutes from Flinders Street Station (to the Birrarung Marr entrance), 10 minutes from Richmond Station and 11 minutes from Jolimont Station (to the Garden Square entrance); trams back to the city one hour after the end of play; the Route 246 bus along Punt Road between Clifton Hill and Elsternwick via St Kilda; and the Free Tram Zone extended on weekdays to include Melbourne Park for ticket holders on the day of the ticket. The 2027 plan was not yet published on 30 October 2026.
